posts.text:
Neil Young, Dreamin' Man, Live '92.

[Image omitted]

I love this package.  But I don't understand why this package doesn't contain a hell of a lot more.  I know this tour wasn't just the Harvest Moon songs, so why not a compilation with the best versions of all the songs performed on the tour?  I'm not the kind of dink who would insist on one complete show, but this seems like a wasted opportunity to me.  Still... excellent.
